name: Topstep
legal_entity_and_hq: Topstep LLC (Delaware LLC; programs operated by affiliate TopstepTrader, LLC), Chicago, Illinois, USA. Mailing address in Terms of Use: 130 S Jefferson St, Chicago, IL 60661
platforms: Quantower (via TopstepX, Combine and XFA only)
instruments: CME, CBOT, NYMEX and COMEX futures (equity index, FX futures, energy, metals, grains, Treasuries, livestock, crypto micros); no spot forex

programs.name: Trading Combine (Standard path) -> Express Funded Account (XFA)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (Maximum Loss Limit rises with end-of-day balance, never moves down, monitored in real time including unrealized P&L). Combine: locks once it reaches the starting balance. XFA: locks at $0 once balance reaches $2,000 profit on 50K, and is set to $0 after the first payout.
programs.consistency_rule: Combine: best day must be at or below 55% of the profit target; exceeding it raises the target (best day / 0.55), it does not fail the account. XFA Standard path: none.
programs.profit_split: 90/10 (traders who joined the new dashboard before Jan 12, 2026 keep 100% of their first $10,000 lifetime profit)
programs.payout_frequency: After every 5 winning days of $150+ net P&L (not consecutive)
programs.payout_rules_note: XFA Standard: up to 50% of account balance per request, capped at $2,000 on 50K ($4,000 if a DLL was added at checkout on a new Combine bought from June 2, 2026 - limited-time offer). Minimum payout $125. Must be net profitable since the last payout (first payout exempt). After each payout the MLL resets to $0. Up to 5 active XFAs. Back2Funded: reactivate a lost XFA (before first payout) for $599 on 50K, up to 2 times.
programs.notes: Daily Loss Limit is optional in the Combine/XFA, chosen at purchase ($1,000 on 50K); hitting it flattens and pauses trading, not a violation. No minimum days stated; Topstep says you can pass in as few as two days. Max position 5 minis / 50 micros. Activation fee is one-time per XFA; no monthly fee after passing. One free Reset Credit per rebill.

programs.name: Trading Combine (No Activation Fee path) -> Express Funded Account (XFA)
programs.consistency_rule: Combine: 55% of profit target (raises target if exceeded). XFA Consistency path: best day must be 40% or less of total net profit to request a payout.
programs.payout_frequency: Standard XFA path: every 5 winning days of $150+; Consistency XFA path: after at least 3 trading days with the 40% consistency met
programs.payout_rules_note: XFA Consistency path: up to 50% of balance, capped at $3,000 on 50K ($6,000 with the limited-time DLL offer). Standard path caps as in the Standard program. Minimum payout $125.
programs.notes: Higher monthly price, no XFA activation fee. Adding a DLL at purchase gives a $10/month 'Responsible Trading' discount on the 50K No Activation Fee Combine. Paths cannot be changed after purchase. The XFA payout path (Standard or Consistency) is a separate choice from the Combine purchase path.

news_trading: Restricted: prohibited to purposefully trade your full maximum position size directly into a scheduled major news event
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: custom automated strategies are allowed through the TopstepX/ProjectX API ($29/month, 50% off with code 'topstep'), but not on Live Funded Accounts; HFT and software that gives an 'unfair advantage' are prohibited; VPS/VPN use is prohibited
copy_trading: Restricted: TopstepX has a built-in Trade Copier between your own Trading Combine and XFA accounts (not Live Funded Accounts); coordinated trading with other people or third-party accounts is prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: all positions must be closed by 3:10 PM CT each weekday (risk managers start flattening at 3:08 PM CT); no overnight or weekend holding
restricted_countries_note: About 35 countries/regions restricted by citizenship and residency, including Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, Kosovo, Iran, Nigeria, Pakistan, Morocco, Kenya and Venezuela. US is not restricted. List: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284116-am-i-eligible-to-trade-with-topstep
path_to_live: Topstep's Risk Team calls traders up from the XFA to a Live Funded Account at its discretion; all XFAs close at call-up. The LFA starts with 20% of transferred funds tradable (min $10,000) and 80% in reserve, released in 25% steps at profit milestones ($3K on 50K). LFA payouts: 5 winning days of $150+ per cycle, up to 50% of balance with no cap; daily payouts unlock after 30 winning days in the LFA.

affiliate_program.notes: Approval-only; contact partners@topstep.com. Code users can redeem one affiliate code per lifetime on a first Prop Program purchase.

recent_changes_2026.change: New traders get a flat 90/10 split; those who joined the new dashboard before this date keep 100% of their first $10,000.
Limited-time offer: adding a Daily Loss Limit at checkout on a new Trading Combine doubles XFA per-request payout caps.
Topstep Labs launched limited 'drops', starting with a $25K Static Drawdown Trading Combine (June) and a $50K Static Drawdown Combine (October 2026).
Wise payouts restored for traders in China, Canada and the UK.
Third-party trackers report loss-limit documentation briefly switched to static daily limits (about April 21) and back to EOD trailing (about May 10); not confirmed on Topstep's own pages.

pros: Low entry price: $49/month for the 50K Standard Combine.
Choice of Standard (lower monthly price, $149 activation) or No Activation Fee path ($95/month, $0 activation).
Optional daily loss limit; hitting it only pauses trading and is not a rule violation.
Many payout methods, including same-day Prop-to-Brokerage and Aeropay for US traders; $125 minimum payout.
Defined path to a live account with uncapped payouts and daily payouts after 30 winning days.
cons: Monthly subscription continues until you pass or cancel.
XFA per-request payout cap is $2,000 (Standard) or $3,000 (Consistency) on 50K, without the limited-time DLL offer.
TopstepX is the only platform listed for new traders; VPS/VPN use is prohibited.
Lower Trustpilot score than peers (3.7 from about 15,000 reviews).
Frequent 2026 rule and payout changes; Topstep's help articles show relative dates only, with no changelog.
best_for: Futures day traders who want a low monthly entry price, an optional daily loss limit and an established path to a live account, and who are fine trading on TopstepX.
